domain: Political Economy / Monetary Theory / Technology Governance
topic_summary: Analysis of cryptocurrency as a contested kernel with three competing interpretations: sound money (fixed-supply monetary alternative), speculative asset (volatility-driven investment vehicle), and decentralization ideology (disintermediation governance project). The research context reveals incompatible success criteria across readings, suggesting three distinct kernels sharing a name rather than three readings of one kernel.

key_entities: Wall Street/Institutional Investors (validators of speculative asset reading)
Crypto Anarchist Movement (ideological foundation for decentralization reading)
Mining Pools/Large Token Holders (concentration of power despite decentralization claims)
Exchanges (centralized intermediaries in supposedly disintermediated system)
Fork Communities (BTC, BCH, ETH, ETC, BSV - governance dispute manifestations)
Warren Buffett/Nobel Laureates (critics of speculative bubble interpretation)
15% of American Adults (retail adoption base as of 2021)
key_tensions: Decentralization promise vs actual mining/holdings concentration
Disintermediation ideology vs emergence of new intermediaries (exchanges, developers)
Original peer-to-peer cash vision vs institutional adoption reality
Governance legitimacy: collective validation vs democratic participation

commitment_system_recognition.kernel_description: Cryptocurrency as shared technological substrate with contested interpretive commitments about its fundamental purpose and legitimacy criteria
commitment_system_recognition.authority_description: Fragmented: Austrian economists (sound money), market participants (speculation), cryptoanarchist developers (decentralization). No unified interpretive authority.
commitment_system_recognition.kernel_collapse_reason: Three supposed readings do not share a common substrate. Sound money reading grounds legitimacy in monetary theory (fixed supply, purchasing power). Speculative asset reading grounds legitimacy in market dynamics (volatility, narrative momentum). Decentralization ideology reading grounds legitimacy in governance structure (disintermediation, distributed control). These are three DISTINCT kernels sharing the name 'cryptocurrency' — not three interpretations of one kernel. Each has incompatible success criteria: sound money requires price stability, speculation requires volatility, decentralization requires distributed power. No single coherent framework could hold all three as complementary readings of the same commitment. The substrate is the blockchain technology itself, but the normative commitments about what makes it legitimate are orthogonal.
commitment_system_recognition.structural_implication: Decompose into three independent constraint axes (one per kernel) rather than kernel/reading structure. Each axis represents a distinct extractive relationship with different beneficiaries, victims, and observables.

axes.human_readable: Sound Money Scarcity Constraint (Fixed Supply as Monetary Legitimacy)
axes.structural_delta: 21 million coin cap creates artificial scarcity claimed as monetary legitimacy vs fiat inflation
axes.primary_observable: Bitcoin supply schedule adherence; purchasing power stability vs fiat currencies; adoption as medium of exchange (not store of value)
axes.selection_reason: Distinct observable (supply cap + purchasing power stability) with clear beneficiary/victim structure. Upstream to speculation axis. Represents first kernel (monetary theory).

axes.human_readable: Institutional Speculation Extraction (Volatility as Profit Mechanism)
axes.structural_delta: Extreme price volatility enables speculative profit extraction by sophisticated actors at expense of retail investors
axes.primary_observable: Price volatility metrics; retail vs institutional trading volume; bubble/bust cycle frequency; narrative-driven price movements
axes.selection_reason: Highest centrality. Downstream synthesis node. Distinct observable (volatility) and beneficiary structure (institutional vs retail). Represents second kernel (speculative asset). Directly contradicts sound money reading's stability requirement.

axes.human_readable: Decentralization-Concentration Paradox (Ideology vs Actual Power Distribution)
axes.structural_delta: Disintermediation ideology coexists with mining concentration, exchange dominance, and technical aristocracy
axes.primary_observable: Mining pool concentration (Gini coefficient); exchange custody share; governance participation rates; developer influence metrics
axes.selection_reason: Independent from first two axes (different observable: power distribution vs price/supply). Represents third kernel (decentralization ideology). Captures tension between stated ideology and structural reality.

axes.structural_delta: Major forks (BTC, BCH, ETH, ETC, BSV) instantiate incompatible governance philosophies from shared codebase
axes.primary_observable: Fork frequency; community size distribution across forks; governance mechanism differences
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: downstream manifestation of decentralization_concentration_paradox without independent extractive structure. Omega material on governance legitimacy.

axes.structural_delta: Quantum computing threatens cryptographic foundation of blockchain security
axes.primary_observable: Quantum computing capability milestones; protocol upgrade timelines; cryptographic algorithm transitions
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: physical constraint (mountain) but low current epsilon. Omega variable on long-term viability.

axes.human_readable: Institutional Adoption Legitimacy Trade (Mainstream Success vs Original Vision)
axes.structural_delta: Wall Street adoption validates speculative reading while undermining decentralization ideology
axes.primary_observable: Institutional custody share; ETF adoption; regulatory compliance requirements
axes.selection_reason: Deferred: high centrality but captured by combination of institutional_speculation_extraction (speculative mechanism) and decentralization_concentration_paradox (ideology vs reality). Would create redundancy.

deferred_axes.deferral_reason: Downstream manifestation of decentralization_concentration_paradox without independent extractive structure

omegas.description: The three supposed readings (sound money, speculation, decentralization) are not three interpretations of one kernel but three distinct kernels sharing the name 'cryptocurrency'. Each has incompatible success criteria and orthogonal normative commitments. Sound money requires stability; speculation requires volatility; decentralization requires distributed power. No coherent framework holds all three simultaneously. This is not a contested kernel but a naming collision across three separate constraint systems.
omegas.source: §1.3 Commitment System Recognition + §1.3-K Kernel/Reading Decomposition coherence test

omegas.description: Which fork (BTC, BCH, ETH, ETC, BSV) inherits the 'true' cryptocurrency kernel? Each claims different interpretive authority (immutability, flexibility, transparency, privacy). Deferred axis fork_governance_fragmentation documents this fragmentation but does not resolve legitimacy question.

Is quantum_threat_horizon a true Mountain (physics of cryptography) or a Piton (policy choice to upgrade protocols)? If quantum computing advances faster than protocol upgrades, the entire substrate collapses. If upgrades succeed, it becomes a coordination Rope. Current low epsilon may be catastrophically wrong.
omegas.source: Deferred axis quantum_threat_horizon + F03 (Hasty Generalization) on mountain classification

omegas.description: Do algorithmic stablecoins or CBDC (central bank digital currencies) bypass the sound money vs speculation contradiction by offering stability without decentralization? If so, they represent a fourth kernel not analyzed here.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — stablecoins and CBDCs not addressed in extraction

omegas.description: Proof-of-work mining energy consumption is an unexamined axis. Who bears the environmental cost (victim) and who benefits (miners extracting block rewards)? This may be a high-epsilon Snare deferred due to token budget.
omegas.source: Dark Matter Probe 2 (Absence Inventory) — energy/environmental impact absent from extraction

omegas.description: Does regulatory compliance (KYC/AML requirements on exchanges) convert decentralization ideology from Tangled Rope to Snare by forcing intermediary gatekeeping? Deferred axis institutional_adoption_legitimacy_trade touches this but does not isolate the regulatory mechanism.
omegas.source: Deferred axis institutional_adoption_legitimacy_trade + Tension 3 (disintermediation vs new intermediaries)
